source: यहाँ आपातकालीन स्थिति है, तुरंत मदद भेजें।
reference: This is an emergency situation, send help immediately.

source: मरीज को तुरंत अस्पताल ले जाना है।
reference: The patient needs to be taken to the hospital immediately.

source: इमारत में आग लगी है, फायर ब्रिगेड को बुलाएं।
reference: There is a fire in the building, call the fire brigade.

source: અહીં પાણી ભરાઈ ગયું છે અને લોકો ફસાયેલા છે.
reference: Water is flooded here and people are trapped.
Doctors are urgently needed in the hospital.
A fire has broken out in the building, please help.
